question: Sohan and Amit started a car race from the same point in the same direction and at the same time on a circular track of length 1125 m with speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively. After how much time (in seconds) will they meet for the first time since the start of the race?
solution:
**Given:- **

Sohan's speed = 36 km/h = (36 × 1000 m) / (3600 s) = 10 m/s

Amit's speed = 54 km/h = (54 ×1000 m) / (3600 s) = 15 m/s

**Formula used:-**

Two trains/bodies are moving in the same direction at u m/s & v m/s,

where u>v then the relative speed in the same direction = (u - v) m/s.

**Calculation:-**

Relative speed = Amit's speed - Sohan's speed 

⇒15 m/s - 10 m/s = 5 m/s

Time (t) = Distance (d) / Relative Speed

Time (t) = 1125 m / 5 m/s = 225 seconds

**∴ Sohan and Amit will meet for the first time since the start of the race after__ 225 __seconds**.
